parent_result.cause: The locked v2 judge emits JSON value while LakatoTree replay parses metric=<float>.

question: Can a byte-stable adapter delegate to the unchanged locked v2 judge and satisfy LakatoTree's numeric producer-replay contract without changing the engineering result?
success_conditions: The adapter rejects any base-receipt or locked-v2-judge SHA drift.
The adapter delegates all nine engineering gate decisions to the locked v2 judge.
A local positional replay exits zero and prints metric=1.
LakatoTree producer replay records server_regenerated rather than client_asserted.
kill_conditions: The adapter duplicates or changes any v2 fault-gate decision.
The v2 receipt or v2 judge is edited to obtain a new verdict.
Server replay remains mismatch after the positional metric contract is satisfied.
The adapter is presented as new HSWM scientific evidence.
claim_boundary: Measurement-sovereignty repair only; the v2 partial receipt remains immutable and no larger-AI hypothesis is judged.
